content: Market landscape of expense tracker apps (Money Manager 10M+ downloads 4.8 stars, YNAB 102K reviews, Spendee 4.7, Bluecoins 1M+): manual expense/income entry, per-type categories, monthly summaries, budgets, charts, export, sync/backup are universal. Manual entry + categories + monthly totals are the absolute floor; every competitor has them. Budgets, charts, export, and cloud sync appear in all major products.
